A by-product is a test of whether call type still matters once recognition is accounted for. Without the gate the likelihood-ratio statistic of call type for approach is 4.49 (⟦M0004⟧); with the gate at 0.5 it drops to 0.91 (⟦M0005⟧). Flat calls rarely elicit ap-proach because beyond 80 m they are below the recognition threshold, not because penguins are less attracted by them.
